children: Galaxy Digital has added $100 million of Sky Protocol yield-bearing savings token sUSDS to its corporate treasury and included it as collateral for its institutional business serving more than 1,600 counterparties. According to Odaily, the company also bought an undisclosed amount of SKY.

Galaxy customers can use sUSDS as loan collateral while continuing to earn Sky Savings Rate returns during the life of the loan. Galaxy's institutional lending business has an average loan size of about $1.4 billion, and Sky ecosystem Prime Agent Grove previously provided it with a $500 million warehouse credit line.

title: Galaxy Digital Adds $100 Million in Sky Protocol sUSDS to Corporate Treasury
